opus.problem: The jawbone appears in only one short episode (Judges 15:14-19), so the Bible does not give 7 different facts about it. The clues retell the same few verses over and over. Under the rules, this word should be swapped for a spare.

Nearly the same fact as clue 1, from the same verse: Samson takes it up and uses it to fight or strike down the Philistines. Samson killing a thousand men with it is also the best-known detail about the jawbone, so on its own this clue gives the word away and is not medium hard.

The song fact (piling the enemies into heaps) overlaps with clue 2's thousand men struck down, since the verse's 'thousand men' line is the same victory. Paired with Samson, this clue also gives the word away on its own and is not medium hard.
Says nearly the same thing as clue 6: the ropes on Samson's arms fall away and he grabs this to fight. Both come from Judges 15:14-15.
Repeats clue 5 (Samson bound with ropes, breaks free, uses this as a weapon) and clue 1 (takes it up as a weapon against the Philistines). It is not a different fact.
